name: Hermannplatz → Argentinische Allee
note: User-specified street chain, stitched directly from OSM street geometry so it crosses Hohenzollerndammbrücke instead of detouring around it, and stops exactly where Clayallee meets Argentinische Allee (Oskar-Helene-Heim) instead of overshooting. The Hohenzollerndamm→Clayallee gap is bridged via Grunewald forest paths, since no single named street connects them. The endpoint sits right by Grunewald forest and the Krumme Lanke lake.

name: Hallesches Tor → Flughafensee
note: Starts right at Hallesches Tor and heads north up Friedrichstraße. Verified via exact OSM node-ID matching (not distance approximation, since "Chausseestraße" is a common name reused across the region): Friedrichstraße ends exactly where Chausseestraße begins, which ends exactly where Müllerstraße begins — one continuous corridor through Mitte and Wedding. Kurt-Schumacher-Damm to the lakeshore is a short unnamed connector.

name: KitKatClub → Krossinsee
note: Verified via OSM geometry: Am Treptower Park, Köpenicker Landstraße, Schnellerstraße and Adlergestell connect end-to-end with no gaps — Adlergestell is one of Berlin's most famous long straight roads. Short unnamed connectors link KitKatClub to the start and Adlergestell to the Krossinsee shoreline.

name: Zeiss-Großplanetarium → Stößensee
note: Follows Berlin's famous straight east-west axis: Unter den Linden → Straße des 17. Juni → Kaiserdamm → Heerstraße, through the Brandenburg Gate and Grunewald. Start (Planetarium) to Alexanderplatz is a short unnamed connector; Alexanderplatz is a waypoint, not the true start.
